title: Trial Refund on the Set's Ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Trial refund on the set's ticket — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The trial refund on the set's ticket is the tire price paid plus the refunded installation part, rounded half up to the cent; disposal fees and any rotation charges are never returned, and valve stems and TPMS service kits stay on the vehicle's wheels and are not refunded.

- **Tire price paid** — the tire count times the price per tire, less the line's set instant savings when the ticket had at least the line's tires-needed figure of tires, less the fleet discount taken on the tires invoice posted for the vehicle on the purchase date when the ticket was charged to a fleet account. The fleet discount on a tires invoice is one percentage taken on every discountable line of the ticket, the tire price, the mounting and the valve-stem or TPMS-kit lines alike; wherever the tire price paid takes it off, the whole discount amount of that invoice is counted against the tire price, the part taken on the mounting and kit lines included, because those lines are never figured below the line's own charges here, and a ticket of an ordered set carries the tire price alone.
- **Refunded installation part** — the tire count times the line's mount-and-balance charge per tire when the line returns installation charges with the tires, and 0 otherwise.

None of these parts is rounded on its own; the trial refund is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end, and is returned to the tender that paid the set's ticket, or as store credit for an exchange.

**Worked (hypothetical 4-tire set at $130.00 a tire with $80.00 set savings, on a line returning installation at $25.00 a tire, paid by card):** tire price paid $440.00; installation part $100.00; refund $540.00. On a line that does not return installation, the refund is $440.00.
